title: Murder on the High Seas
summary: An estate agent (later revealed to be a scammer) was found bludgeoned to death on a boat while the main suspects were all on a nearby beach.
method: The killer hid in the cargo hold of the boat and waited for everyone else to leave on the dinghy before murdering the estate agent. He then swam back to the island, behind the other passengers who were on a dinghy to the beach.
motive: The killer was betrayed by the victim in the past. They had targeted criminals in the past for scams and the killer was abandoned by the victim and left badly hurt when those criminals took revenge.
killer: The clerk at the convenience store nearby, who used to know the victim.
